name: Snake Block Wipe
description: Blocks switch to the second clip one at a time, row after row from the top, each row running the opposite way to the one before, like a snake winding across the frame. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: vertical
params.description: Wind down the columns from the left instead of along the rows

params.name: smoothness
params.description: How long each block takes to fade in, in turns of one block (0 switches it at once)
